Chapter 1117: 35: The Great Lord Is Invincible (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1117: Chapter 35: The Great Lord is Invincible (Seeking Subscription)_2

Winning won’t vastly enhance one’s prestige and reputation, but if lost, the Spirit Might King will be branded a sinner of the ancient kingdom, and the punishment will be severe.

Being imprisoned for a billion years would be considered lenient.

“Indeed.”

The Red Pine King nodded.

The cost of escalating the war’s intensity far exceeds that of losing a normal war.

“How is the current situation?” King Chijue casually asked.

“It’s acceptable. In the slaughter between the Great Lords, the Spirit Might King has a slight advantage, but not by much. As long as you, third brother, can hold off the King Lingshen, the Spirit Might King won’t be able to do anything to me.”

The Red Pine King was very confident. In terms of battlefield strategy, he believed he had reached perfection; unless the opponent’s power was overwhelming, they could not penetrate his defense.

“I heard you tacitly allowed a Great Lord to comprehend the war machine?” King Chijue looked down on the battlefield and asked.

“Yes, it’s the Galaxy Great Lord, a newly-promoted Great Lord, a disciple of Qingfen, with considerable potential.” The Red Pine King nodded. Privately allowing an outsider to comprehend the war machine clearly violated the regulations of the ancient kingdom.

If anyone else asked, the Red Pine King would surely deny it, feigning ignorance, but King Chijue?

His third brother, the Red Pine King naturally told the truth.

“You think highly of him?”

King Chijue smiled, not overly concerned.

For him, even a newly-promoted Great Lord, or even a peak Great Lord, was unworthy of his attention.

A core figure of the royal family, even without reaching the ultimate level, could easily sweep across the same rank.

…

Zone Yi Shisan Defense Area.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his aura deep and restrained.

After five hundred years, Lin Yuan had completely integrated the Fierce Sun’s source into his internal universe, the true body of the Chaos Void primordial spirit, the true body and primordial spirit of this source world, all of which had merged and devoured the Fierce Sun’s source.

“How miraculous.”

Lin Yuan gazed down at his internal universe, where a blazing sun sat at the center, its radiance illuminating the eight-direction universe.

“My current strength should surpass the peak Great Lords.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, at this moment, his internal universe had integrated and devoured the Fierce Sun’s source, equivalent to continuously maintaining the ‘Fierce Sun Opening the Sky’ divine skill, with such profound foundations that even without utilizing any rule methods, he could suppress peak Great Lords with sheer fundamental strength.

“As for the Heavenly Venerate?”

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart. The Heavenly Venerate of this source world was equivalent to the Great Saints of the Chaos Void. Having never truly fought them, Lin Yuan was unsure who was stronger.

“Now, in this Fang Yuan World, I finally have the power to protect myself.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. Although he did not know if he could rival a Heavenly Venerate, it was clear that a Heavenly Venerate would find it very difficult to deal with him. Even if he couldn’t win, self-preservation was achievable.

Heavenly Venerate was already considered a top-tier combat force; above them were the emperors of various ancient kingdoms and the forefathers.

The emperors of the ancient kingdoms had combat power that surpassed the Heavenly Venerates because they wielded weapons bestowed by the forefathers. Yet, these weapons were not easily deployed.

And there were many limiting conditions.

Therefore, as long as Lin Yuan was careful, the threat from the emperors of ancient kingdoms could likewise be ignored.

“Only the last Grade A war machine has yet to be fully comprehended.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. Over the past five hundred years, nearly all the war machines on the battlefield had been comprehended by him.

Only the last Grade A war machine remained, and it was nearly fully comprehended. At Lin Yuan’s rate of comprehension, it could be the next moment, or a few months away.

“Chaos Rule…”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned contemplative. He had comprehended nearly all the chaos secret patterns within the war machines, and now his understanding of the Chaos Rule was only a tiny bit away from reaching the Second Realm peak.

“It’s just the final Seed of the Fierce Sun….”

Lin Yuan’s brow slightly furrowed. Over the past five hundred years, his cultivation in all aspects had leapt forward, but the Seed of the Fierce Sun remained stuck.

The thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-third Seed of the Fierce Sun was extremely close to being fully condensed, yet that final step hadn’t been taken.

“Is there a limitation or shackle that I’m unaware of?”

Lin Yuan pondered secretly, planning to investigate once he had fully comprehended the last war machine.

“Hmm?”

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed as he looked towards the battlefield.

Great Venerate Changfeng, leading numerous war machines, launched a large-scale attack here.

“Attacking again?”

Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow. It had been less than half a year since the last attack. Typically, the interval between attacks was at least in the tens of years.

After all, war machines needed repairs, and Great Lords required rest.

…

Above the Yi Shisan Defense Line battlefield.

Lin Yuan and Great Venerate Changfeng faced each other from a distance.

“Galaxy, be cautious in the next phase.”

Great Venerate Changfeng secretly transmitted a message, reminding him.

In the five hundred years of battle, Lin Yuan and Great Venerate Changfeng had established a tacit understanding, never fighting to the death. The two had developed a deep bond.

In fact, for the Great Venerates, friendships were not bound by Ancient Country restrictions. The Great Venerates of Fierce Sun Ancient Country and Da Ling Ancient Country also maintained very good relations.

Many Great Venerates would even travel through various Ancient Countries, serving different Ancient Countries every few years.

“Be cautious?”

Lin Yuan’s expression subtly changed.

Great Venerate Changfeng’s reminder was certainly not aimed at cautioning Lin Yuan about him.

Throughout five hundred years, despite Lin Yuan concealing his strength, solely the techniques he displayed were challenging enough for Great Venerate Changfeng to handle.

“Is Spirit Might King preparing to initiate the final battle?”

Lin Yuan also transmitted a message inquiring.

“Yes.” Great Venerate Changfeng hesitated for a moment, then nodded.

The matter was no secret. Even if he didn’t reveal it, Lin Yuan would soon find out, as all of the Great Venerates on Spirit Might King’s side had already gathered at the core frontline battlefield.

“Final battle?”

Lin Yuan looked towards the core frontline battlefield.

…

Core Frontline Battlefield.

Time and space were heavy, the aura of the peak Great Venerates pervading, as mighty war machines faced off against each other.

Lord Qingfen, Great Venerate Hongye, and other peak Great Venerates wore solemn expressions. The battle between the two domains had been long prepared for, and after five hundred years of clash, both sides had thoroughly probed each other.

Now comes the final battle phase.

The duration of the final battle phase will not be short, but both sides will undoubtedly fight with all their might, utilizing hidden trump cards previously kept in reserve.

“The final battle, the most brutal battlefield, will certainly be the core frontline battlefield. The Galaxy side should not be affected yet.”

Lord Qingfen’s thoughts drifted as he glanced at the distant Yi Shisan frontline battlefield.

Rumble.

The next moment.

Both sides’ peak Great Venerates engaged in full combat.

Unlike in the past when only a few peak Great Venerates fought fiercely, this time all peak Great Venerates struck with full strength, holding back nothing.

Around Lord Qingfen, time and space began to burn with blue flames, the intangible fire spreading to cover all directions.

Other peak Great Venerates also unleashed various techniques in succession, causing large areas of time and space in this battlefield region to collapse, even affecting the clashes between the mighty war machines below.

“Return of Ten Thousand Ways.”

In the direction of the Purple Dream Domain, a burly peak Great Venerate stepped forward, causing the surrounding world to crumble, influencing all peak Great Venerates including Lord Qingfen.

“Such a technique?”

Lord Qingfen’s expression subtly changed.

Other Great Venerates felt similarly, vaguely sensing that the chaotic evolving powers they mastered began to be suppressed and weakened.

At the rear of the battlefield.

Red Pine King and King Chijue wore solemn expressions.

“I must intervene.”

King Chijue spoke, as the burly peak Great Venerate from the Purple Dream Domain was evidently Spirit Might King’s hidden trump card. His strength could affect the battle situation among more than a dozen peak Great Venerates.

If King Chijue did not intervene to stop it, the peak Great Venerates on the Qingfen Domain’s side would likely fall into a disadvantageous position.

“Yes.”

Red Pine King nodded, seeing that the battlefield situation was indeed unfavorable to his side.

Buzz buzz buzz.

On the battlefield, the sky seemed forcibly torn open, a substantial amount of crimson flames converging as the burly peak Great Venerate rapidly retreated several steps.

“King Chijue.”

The expression of the burly peak Great Venerate became serious.

A silhouette appeared unknown when above all the peak Great Venerates, eyes burning like a fierce sun.

However.

Before many peak Great Venerates could react.

“Chijue.”

A mysterious divine aura permeated, a figure appearing opposite King Chijue with a smile on his face: “Let me see the techniques of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s royal family.”
